answer: Each agent must exclusively occupy one jetty berth beside a glacier and serially extract, measure, then destroy a unique shale core whose live density signature binds to its key. The panel verifies the signature against public satellite and buoy streams while confirming continuous exclusive berth occupancy for the full serial window. Extraction is strictly sequential and non-parallelizable; every extra identity needs its own scarce berth, core, and full schedule, so attacker cost grows super-linearly and cannot be pooled.
